subject: Request: One-time comp + equity exception for Sr. Eng after org move
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: One-time comp + equity exception for Sr. Eng after org move

Hi Monica / Vivek,

Quick note requesting a one-time compensation exception for Rohit Mehta (Sr. Software Engineer, Platform). He moved teams in January as part of the Platform reorg and is at risk of leaving — two offers surfaced in the last month. I discussed retention options with the hiring manager and we propose the following one-time package to keep him engaged through H2 product launches:

- $7,500 one-time cash retention bonus (paid in March)
- Equity refresh: 3,000 RSUs (one-time grant, cliff vesting 1 year)
- Minor base salary alignment: +6% (effective next pay period) — manager requests out-of-cycle adjustment due to market mismatch after role change

Rationale (short):
- Market comp gap vs. Marketplace benchmark ~12% for this level in SF market (benchmarks attached).
- Critical domain knowledge on the platform migration; replacement risk would meaningfully impact roadmap timelines.
- Manager has limited budget for promotion cycle; this is a retention exception request.

Attached: manager_summary.docx with role context, market comps snapshot, and manager sign-off.

As this is an exception vs. normal comp cycles, please advise on approvals required and whether we should route this to Finance/CFO for sign-off. If helpful I can join a quick call.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Engineering (Platform)
Redwood Inference
[attachment: manager_summary.docx (DOCX, 34 KB)]
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: One-time comp + equity exception for Sr. Eng after org move

Laura — thanks for the context and the doc. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I escalate:

1) Is the +6% base increase recurring (new base) or a one-time adjustment to be treated as a promotion? Please confirm if budget exists in the manager's headcount/comp line.
2) Proposed RSU count (3,000) — can you share current outstanding grant + run-rate? We need to validate against band caps.
3) Does Rohit have other offers with written terms we can reference (title/total comp)? That helps approve speed.

I attached the current comp_guidelines.pdf for band caps and exception thresholds. For an exception of this size, we will need: 
- People Ops approval (me)
- Finance / Compensation partner sign-off (Vivek can advise on the finance gate)
- Final exec approval if equity exceeds band limits

If you can answer the Qs and send any offer evidence, I’ll prep a short summary for Finance and route for sign-off. Happy to spin up a 15m call today.

-Monica
Monica Patel
Senior People Operations Manager, Compensation
Redwood Inference
[attachment: comp_guidelines.pdf (PDF, 280 KB)]

Thanks — answers inline below and I pasted the manager's note at the bottom.

1) +6% is intended as a permanent base alignment (not a one-off bonus). Manager has no additional headcount budget but has a small discretionary line; if base increase needs to be funded centrally we understand that.

2) Current outstanding grant: 12,000 RSUs (vest schedule 4y). This would be a top-up. Manager considered 4,000 RSUs but pulled back to 3,000 to remain within precedent for the level.

3) Offer evidence: second-round written offer came in at $195k total cash + 2,500 RSUs from a stealth startup; candidate asked manager for counter. I’ve attached the anonymized offer excerpt (pulled from manager notes) in the manager_summary.docx.

Manager note (copy):
"Rohit has been leading the runtime rewrite; losing him delays two sprints and risks delivery of the streaming KV cache work. He made clear he'd consider leaving if we don't address comp quickly. Team morale is fragile post-reorg. I recommend the package above as it aligns to market and preserves internal equity"

If you want, Vivek and I can meet Finance for a quick decision; I can be available 11:30–12:00 PST today.

-L

On Wed, Feb 10, 2027 at 10:05 Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: One-time comp + equity exception for Sr. Eng after org move

Appreciate the fast follow and good summary. From Finance perspective:

- Cash bonus ($7.5k): OK from discretionary retention pool, no exec required. Finance can route for payment if People Ops approves.
- Base increase (+6%): this creates ongoing run-rate impact. We need the manager to confirm long-term funding source (reallocate or centralize). If reallocated from team budget, we can approve.
- RSU refresh (3,000): this exceeds typical refresh for a level without exec review. I will provisionally support routing to exec for a one-time approval if People Ops confirms that band cap will be exceeded and provides manager justification.

Please prepare a one-pager for exec that includes: current comp table, market comps (benchmarks), flight risk evidence, and proposed timeline for vesting. Monica — once you confirm band breach I’ll open the approval ticket with CFO and include a finance recommendation.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Finance Operations
